The selection process may include an online test, a psychometric test, or any other test the Bank deems suitable, followed by an Interview or multiple interviews. The Bank may shortlist applications based on criteria such as suitability for the role, depth of prior experience, leadership exposure, domain expertise, professional certifications, and exposure to regulatory or compliance frameworks. The minimum qualifying mark for the Personal Interview (PI) is 60% for UR category and 55% for Reserved category candidates.

How to Apply Online for Bank of Baroda IT Recruitment 2026

Applications for these posts can only be submitted online, with no other mode accepted. Here is the step-by-step process candidates need to follow.

  1. Visit the Bank's official website and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities page.
  2. Register online using the application format enabled for this recruitment.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, since no changes are allowed after clicking SUBMIT.
  4. Upload your Bio-data, scanned photograph, signature, and supporting eligibility documents as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Verify all entered details, including name, category, date of birth, and post applied for, before final submission.
  6. Submit the application well before 10-07-2026 to avoid last-minute website load issues.
  7. Save the acknowledgement number generated on the portal and check your registered email for confirmation - registration is complete only once this acknowledgement is received.

Documents and Upload Specifications

Bank of Baroda requires specific documents to be uploaded at the time of application, each with strict file format and size requirements. Getting these specifications wrong is a common reason applications get stuck.

Documents to Upload (Application Stage)

  • Resume (PDF)
  • DOB Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
  • Educational Certificates: relevant mark-sheets/certificates, scanned in a single PDF file
  • Work experience certificates, if applicable (PDF)
  • Caste/Category Certificate, if applicable (PDF)
  • PWD certificate, if applicable (PDF)

Photograph and Signature Specifications

  • Photograph: recent passport-style colour picture, dimensions 200 x 230 pixels, file size between 20kb–50kb.
  • Signature: signed in black ink on white paper, dimensions 140 x 60 pixels, file size between 10kb–20kb.
  • Document files: must be in PDF format, A4 page size, and not exceeding 500 KB each.

Documents Required at Interview Stage

At the time of interview, candidates must produce originals along with self-attested photocopies of documents including the call letter printout, system-generated application printout, date of birth proof, photo identity proof, mark sheets and degree certificates, and category certificates where applicable. Notably, a Ration Card will not be accepted as valid identity proof for this recruitment.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Given the strict, no-correction-after-submission policy of this recruitment, small errors can have a big impact. The following points can help candidates avoid losing their candidature.

  • Do not submit the application without double-checking every field - no changes are allowed once you click SUBMIT.
  • Do not upload a photograph or signature outside the specified pixel and file-size limits, as the system will reject non-compliant files.
  • Do not assume your credit history is irrelevant - a CIBIL score below 680 or any adverse credit report can make you ineligible.
  • Do not delay applying until the last day; server load near the 10-07-2026 deadline can prevent successful submission.
  • Do not carry a Ration Card as your only ID proof for the interview - it will not be accepted.
  • Do not forget to check the position-specific eligibility link for your chosen post, since detailed qualifications differ by role.

The Railway Recruitment Board has released the RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026 on 22 June 2026, giving candidates their first look at where they'll sit for the second-stage exam on 2 July 2026. If you applied under CEN 05/2025 for Junior Engineer, Depot Material Superintendent, or Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant posts, you can now log in with your registration number and date of birth to check your allotted exam city, ahead of the admit card that follows on 28 June 2026.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This guide walks you through the direct download link, the zone-wise login portals, exam shift timings, and exactly what the slip does (and doesn't) tell you so you can start planning your travel right away.

What Is the RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026?

Before downloading anything, it helps to know exactly what this document is and isn't. Here's the short answer: it's an advance notice of your exam city, not your entry ticket to the exam hall.

The city intimation slip is a preliminary notice issued by RRB purely to tell candidates which city their CBT 2 exam centre will fall in. It does not carry the exact venue address, reporting time, or entry instructions those details arrive only with the admit card. The slip exists so candidates have enough lead time to book trains, buses, or accommodation if their allotted city is far from home, rather than scrambling once the admit card lands just days before the exam.

RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026 Direct Download Link

The Railway Recruitment Board activated the city intimation login link on its official regional portals on 22 June 2026. Candidates need to click through to the login page, enter their registration number and date of birth, and the system will display the allotted exam city on screen.

Direct Link: RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026

Keep in mind that the city slip itself is not downloadable as a print-ready hall ticket the way an admit card is it simply displays your allotted city, state, exam date, and shift on screen after login. Note this down or take a screenshot for your own reference.

How to Check the RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026 (Step-by-Step)

If this is your first time accessing the city slip, follow these steps exactly to avoid login errors.

The process is identical across all RRB zones, though each zone uses its own regional website. Here's the complete sequence:

  1. Visit the official website of the RRB zone you applied under (see the zone-wise list below).
  2. On the homepage, look under the "Latest News" or "Notice Board" section for the link reading "CEN 05/2025 RRB JE CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026."
  3. Click the link you'll be redirected to a login page.
  4. Enter your Registration Number (the unique ID sent to your email/mobile after form submission) and your Date of Birth in DDMMYYYY format as the password.
  5. Enter the CAPTCHA code shown on screen.
  6. Click Submit/Login to view your allotted exam city, state, date, and shift.
  7. Note down or screenshot the details for your own records, since this isn't a printable document like the admit card.

What Information Does the RRB JE City Slip Actually Contain?

Knowing what's printed on the slip helps you double-check your own details for accuracy the moment you log in.

The city intimation slip is intentionally limited to preliminary identification and location details nothing related to the exact venue. Specifically, it shows:

  • Candidate's full name
  • Registration number
  • Post applied for (JE/DMS/CMA)
  • Allotted exam city and state
  • Scheduled exam date
  • Assigned shift number

What it does not include: the exact exam centre name, full address, reporting time, or gate closure time. Those appear only on the admit card.

RRB JE CBT 2 Exam Shift Timings 2026

Since the CBT 2 exam runs across three shifts in a single day, knowing your assigned slot matters for planning your morning (or afternoon, or evening).

The exam is conducted as a 120-minute computer-based test, split into three shifts to accommodate the large candidate pool appearing under CEN 05/2025. Reporting and gate closure times are strict, so candidates should plan to arrive well ahead of the listed closure time.

Shift Reporting Time Gate Closure Time Exam Start Time
Shift 1 7:30 AM 8:30 AM 9:00 AM
Shift 2 11:15 AM 12:15 PM 12:45 PM
Shift 3 3:00 PM 4:00 PM 4:30 PM

Your exact shift assignment will be confirmed on both the city intimation slip and, later, the admit card always go by what's printed on your own document rather than assuming a shift based on this table.

RRB JE City Intimation Slip vs Admit Card: What's the Difference?

A lot of candidates confuse the two, so here's a direct comparison to clear that up.

The city slip and the admit card serve entirely different purposes, even though both relate to the same exam. The city slip is informational only; the admit card is your mandatory entry document.

Feature City Intimation Slip Admit Card
Purpose Advance notice to help plan travel Official entry pass for the exam hall
Typical Release Window ~10 days before exam ~4 days before exam
Venue Detail City and state only Full centre name and address
Valid for Exam Entry No Yes, mandatory

RRB JE CBT 2 Admit Card 2026: What Comes Next

Once you've checked your city, the next document to watch for is the admit card the one you'll actually need on exam day.

The RRB JE CBT 2 Admit Card 2026 will be released on 28 June 2026, four days ahead of the 2 July exam. Unlike the city slip, the admit card carries the complete exam centre address, your final reporting time, gate closure time, and exam-day instructions. It must be downloaded, printed, and carried to the centre along with a valid photo ID entry will not be permitted without it.

To download the admit card when it goes live:

  1. Visit your respective regional RRB website.
  2. Click on the RRB JE CBT 2 Admit Card 2026 link.
  3. Log in using your registration number and date of birth.
  4. Download and print the admit card for exam day.

Why the City Intimation Slip Matters for Your Exam Preparation

Beyond just travel logistics, this slip plays a small but useful role in your overall exam-day planning.

For candidates allotted a city outside their home district or state, the 10-day notice window gives enough time to book economical travel and accommodation before prices spike closer to the exam date. It also lets you start factoring in local travel time to the (eventual) centre address once the admit card is out, rather than discovering on day one that your city is several hours from your stay.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) is expected to release the RRB Group D Result 2026 in the 4th week of June 2026 at the official website rrbcdg.gov.in, following the disposal of the Telangana High Court case that had earlier put a hold on the result. Over 1.08 crore candidates who appeared for the Computer Based Test (CBT) under CEN 08/2024 for 32,438 Level 1 vacancies can check their merit list, scorecard, and zone-wise cut off marks once the result is declared. This article covers everything candidates need to know the latest court case update, how to check the result, scorecard details, cut off expectations, and the next stage of selection.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

RRB Group D Result 2026 - Latest Update

This section explains the most recent development in the RRB Group D result timeline, including the court case status and the revised expected release date.

The Telangana High Court has disposed of the petition concerning Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) weightage marks on 16th June 2026, removing the stay that had earlier delayed the result. With the legal hurdle cleared, the Railway Recruitment Board is now expected to declare the RRB Group D Result 2026 in the 4th week of June 2026, along with the scorecard, merit list, and cut off marks. As a precautionary step, the court has directed RRB to keep 15 vacancies reserved until final disposal of the main writ petition, while the remaining 32,423 posts will be filled through the regular recruitment process. RRB has also opened an application modification window for CCAA candidates from 17th June to 23rd June 2026, allowing them to update NCVT certificate details and marks before the result is finalised.

RRB Group D Result 2026 Overview

This section gives a quick snapshot of the exam, vacancies, and important result-related dates for CEN 08/2024 in one place.

Particulars Details
Exam Name RRB Group D
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
Advertisement Number CEN 08/2024

Selection Process CBT, PET, Document Verification, Medical Test
Official Website rrbcdg.gov.in and respective zonal RRB websites

Why Was the RRB Group D Result Delayed?

This section explains the background of the court case that caused the delay in declaring the result.

The result was delayed due to a case filed in the Telangana High Court relating to the weightage given to Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) candidates in the final merit list. The dispute arose after a 2022 policy change by the Skill Development Ministry altered the earlier exemption available to apprenticeship candidates, prompting petitioners to demand restoration of the older selection system. Since the outcome could affect zone-wise rankings and cut off marks, RRB suspended further processing of the result until the court's verdict. With the case now disposed of, the court has directed the Directorate General of Training (DGT) to examine the representations on the 2022 policy change, and has instructed Railway authorities to conduct proper scrutiny of CCAA candidates during document verification.

How to Check RRB Group D Result 2026 at rrbcdg.gov.in

This section lists the step-by-step process candidates need to follow once the result link is activated.

  1. Visit the official website of your respective regional RRB (for example, rrbcdg.gov.in).
  2. Look for the result link titled "CEN-RRB-08/2024 (Pay Level-1 Posts): CBT Result & Score Card."
  3. Click on the relevant zone-wise result/merit list link.
  4. Download the result PDF that appears on the screen.
  5. Use Ctrl + F to search for your registration number or roll number in the PDF.
  6. Log in with your registration number and date of birth to view your individual scorecard.
  7. Download and print the result for future reference.

RRB Group D Scorecard 2026: What It Will Contain

This section explains where the scorecard will be available and what details candidates should verify on it.

The RRB Group D Scorecard 2026 will be released along with the result on the candidate login portal at rrb.digialm.com. Candidates must check every detail on the scorecard carefully to avoid discrepancies later. The scorecard will typically include:

  • Candidate's Name
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth and Gender
  • Roll Number
  • Father's/Mother's Name
  • Category and Quota Sub-Category (if applicable)
  • Total Exam Marks and Marks Scored
  • Total Cut-Off Score
  • RRB Region/Zone Venue

RRB Group D Merit List 2026: Zone-Wise Release

This section explains how the merit list will be structured and how candidates can locate their result within it.

The RRB Group D Merit List 2026 will be released separately for each of the RRB's 21 regional zones in PDF format, containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. Since the list runs into thousands of roll numbers, candidates are advised to use the Ctrl + F search function within the PDF to quickly locate their roll number instead of scrolling manually. The result and merit list will be published on each zone's respective official website, including rrbcdg.gov.in (Chandigarh), rrbmumbai.gov.in, rrbchennai.gov.in, rrbkolkata.gov.in, rrbbpl.nic.in, and other zonal RRB portals.

RRB Group D Cut Off 2026: What to Expect

This section explains how the cut off marks will be determined and where they will be published.

The RRB Group D Cut Off 2026 will be released zone-wise and category-wise (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) along with the result and merit list. Since the CBT was conducted across multiple shifts over several months, RRB applies an equi-percentile normalisation method to ensure fairness raw marks in each shift are converted to a percentile scale, and this normalised score (not the raw score) is used to prepare the final merit list. As per the official notification, the minimum qualifying marks are:

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR / EWS 40%
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / SC 30%
ST 25%

Candidates must clear both the category-wise qualifying marks and the overall zone cut off to be considered for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

What Happens After the RRB Group D Result 2026?

This section explains the next stages in the selection process that follow the result declaration.

Candidates who qualify in the CBT will be shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which is qualifying in nature meaning candidates only need to clear it, and PET marks are not added to the final merit. Those who clear the PET will then proceed to Document Verification, where original certificates, identity proof, and category certificates (including NCVT/CCAA documents, given the recent court directions) must be presented. CCAA candidates should particularly note that RRB will conduct proper scrutiny and eligibility verification of their certificates during this stage, as directed by the Telangana High Court.

Work Experience – Deputy Engineer Grade (Vacancy Nos. 21–25/2026)

  • Minimum 5 years' supervisory work experience in the relevant field (Civil/Track maintenance, Electrical Power Distribution, Railway Signalling, Rolling Stock maintenance, or OCC Operations as applicable); AND
  • Currently working in pay scales with minimum bottom pay of ₹46,000, OR
  • 2 years' experience in pay scales with minimum bottom pay of ₹40,000 and above, OR
  • 5 years' experience in pay scales with minimum bottom pay of ₹37,000 and above.

For CDA pay scale employees (Ministry of Railways / other Govt. Railways):

  • Minimum 5 years' supervisory work experience in the relevant field; AND
  • Working in PB-2 + GP ₹4,200 (Level 6 of 7th CPC); AND
  • Minimum 4 years of Group C service.

For the Deputy Chief Controller (Operations) post specifically, candidates under CDA scales must have 5 years' supervisory experience in maintenance of Rolling Stock and Depot Machinery (not OCC operations) to be eligible. Under IDA scales, the requirement is 5 years' post-qualification supervisory experience in OCC/Station/Train operations with minimum 2 years as Traffic Controller in an OCC equipped with modern OCC systems.

Note on MACP: For CDA-scale employees, higher grade pays granted under MACP by the department will not be considered for eligibility. Only the substantive grade is taken into account for determining the grade of absorption.

Work Experience – Junior Engineer Grade (Vacancy Nos. 26–32/2026)

All posts require a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field within Operations & Maintenance departments of Indian Railways, Government-owned or operated Railways, Metro Railways, or RRTS systems.

The maximum age limit is 45 years for all posts in both groups. Age is reckoned as on 31 May 2026.

The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances - candidates are advised to confirm their eligibility before making payment.

NHSRCL DE & JE Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

For the Deputy Engineer grade (Vacancy Nos. 21–25/2026), selection consists of four stages in this order: Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, Interview, and Medical Examination.

For the Junior Engineer grade (Vacancy Nos. 26–32/2026), selection consists of three stages: Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, and Medical Examination. Note that the Interview stage is not part of the JE-grade selection process.

In both cases, management reserves the right to include or dispense with any stage of the selection methodology. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email addresses. Out-station candidates called for interview (DE grade) will be paid Travelling Allowance as per company rules.

Medical fitness is a mandatory condition of appointment. Candidates will be examined as per the Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM). Additional medical tests such as Audiometry and Perimetry may also be conducted as required for safe operation of High Speed Trains.

Surety Bond and Service Commitment

Candidates selected for absorption must be aware of the following binding commitments before joining NHSRCL.

Surety Bond on Joining: Selected candidates must execute a surety bond of ₹3,00,000/- committing to serve NHSRCL for a minimum period of 4 years (excluding any period on Leave Without Pay or Extra-Ordinary Leave). A prior notice of 90 days is required before resigning from the corporation.

Surety Bond on Training: If training is provided, candidates must execute a separate surety bond for the cost of training plus applicable service tax, committing to serve for a minimum of 6 years after training completion. A three-month prior notice is required before resignation in such cases.

Candidates appointed on absorption basis will be on probation for one year. They may be posted anywhere across NHSRCL offices and the MAHSR Project.

Important Note on Controller and Safety Assignment

Candidates applying for posts that include a Controller or Safety assignment (such as Vacancy Nos. 21–29, 31/2026) must indicate their willingness for such assignments in the online application form. They must also furnish their order of preference between the available designations at the time of application. However, the final allocation of post or assignment rests entirely at NHSRCL's discretion, regardless of the candidate's stated preference.

Document Requirements

Along with the application, candidates must submit a Competency Certificate or Experience Certificate issued by their employer. This certificate must clearly indicate the required work experience with year-wise details of the nature and type of work performed. Incomplete applications or applications submitted without supporting documents will be rejected outright.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Applying for NHSRCL absorption posts is a specialized process. Keep the following in mind to avoid rejection:

  • Do not apply for more than one post within the same vacancy notice group (21–25 or 26–32). Only one application is permitted per group, and both CBT sessions may be held simultaneously.
  • Save your registration credentials immediately after creating your portal account. NHSRCL communicates exclusively through registered email IDs - check your spam folder regularly.
  • Verify eligibility before paying the fee. The ₹400 fee is non-refundable under all circumstances, including ineligibility or withdrawal.
  • If your internet connection drops during payment, do not immediately retry - check your bank statement first to avoid a double payment. Contact your bank if the amount is debited but confirmation is not received.
  • Use an updated browser on a stable connection for the application portal. Avoid submitting on the final day to prevent server congestion issues.
  • Ensure your experience certificate is on your employer's letterhead with year-wise work details - general appointment letters or offer letters alone are not acceptable.

What is the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026?

The HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026 is an official document published by the Himachal Pradesh High Court listing the correct answers to all questions asked in the Driver recruitment written examination. This answer key helps candidates verify their attempted answers against the officially correct responses, allowing them to estimate their expected score and gauge their chances of selection.

  • The answer key is released in PDF format on the official HP High Court website.
  • It lists the correct answers question by question as per the official question paper.
  • Candidates can use it to challenge any incorrect answer within the stipulated objection window.
  • The final result will be based on the final answer key after considering any valid objections.

How to Download HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026

Candidates can download the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026 by following a few simple steps from the official website. Here is the step-by-step process to access and save the answer key PDF.

  1. Visit the official HP High Court website at hphighcourt.nic.in.
  2. Navigate to the Recruitment or Notifications section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link titled "HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026" or related notification.
  4. Click on the answer key link to open the PDF in your browser.
  5. Download and save the PDF for future reference.
  6. Alternatively, you can directly access the answer key PDF using the direct link: hphighcourt.nic.in/pdf/Information062520261782377699.pdf

How to Calculate Your Score Using the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026

Once you have downloaded the official answer key, you can use it to calculate your estimated score. Follow the method below to compute your probable marks based on your responses and the official answer key.

  • Compare each of your answers with the corresponding correct answer mentioned in the official answer key.
  • Add marks for every correct answer as per the official marking scheme.
  • Deduct marks for each wrong answer if a negative marking scheme is applicable (refer to the official notification for negative marking details).
  • Questions left unattempted generally carry no marks.
  • Sum up your total to estimate your probable score in the examination.

How to Raise Objections Against the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026

If any candidate finds a discrepancy or believes that a particular answer in the official answer key is incorrect, they may raise an objection during the objection window. Here is a general process to challenge the answer key.

  • Visit the official HP High Court website at hphighcourt.nic.in.
  • Look for the objection challenge link associated with the Driver Answer Key 2026.
  • Submit your objection within the stipulated time frame along with valid supporting documents or references.
  • Objections submitted after the deadline or without proper justification may not be considered.
  • The HP High Court will review all valid objections and release a final answer key accordingly.

What Happens After the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026?

The release of the answer key is one of the key stages in the HP High Court Driver recruitment process. Here is what candidates can expect in the upcoming stages after the answer key is published.

  • Objection Window: Candidates can challenge incorrect answers during the objection period.
  • Final Answer Key: After reviewing objections, the HP High Court will release a final and revised answer key.
  • Result Declaration: The merit list and result will be prepared based on the final answer key.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification.
  • Final Selection: The final selection of candidates for the post of Driver will be made after all stages are completed.

Important Points to Remember About HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026

Candidates should keep the following important points in mind while using the HP High Court Driver Answer Key 2026 and planning their next steps in the recruitment process.

  • Always download the answer key from the official website only to avoid misinformation.
  • The provisional answer key may differ from the final answer key after objections are reviewed.
  • Do not rely solely on unofficial or third-party answer keys as they may contain errors.
  • Keep your admit card and examination details handy while reviewing the answer key.
  • Regularly check the official HP High Court website for updates on the result and next recruitment stages.

How to View GSSSB Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet 2026

Candidates who appeared in the CBRT exam on 25 June 2026 can view their Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet by following this simple step-by-step process. Only candidates who were present on the day of the exam are eligible to view and raise objections online.

Step 1: Visit the Official Login Portal

Step 2: Log In with Your Credentials

On the login screen, enter the following details and click the Login button:

  • Advertisement Number (Select from the dropdown)
  • Confirmation Number
  • Date of Birth (in DD/MM/YYYY format)

Step 3: Click on the "Candidate Response" Tab

After successful login, click on the "Candidate Response" tab from the top menu to access your response sheet page.

Step 4: Generate Your Response Sheet

Click on the "Click here to generate it" link to load your Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet. Once it loads, click the Print button and use Save as PDF to download a copy of your response sheet to your device for future reference.

How to Submit Online Objections Against GSSSB Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer in the Provisional Answer Key, they can raise an online objection within the specified window (27 June to 3 July 2026). Objections submitted through any other medium (offline, email, post) will not be considered. Here is the complete step-by-step process to raise objections.

Step 1: Click on "Objection Form" Tab

After logging in, click on the "Objection Form" tab. Then click the + (plus/addition sign) button to expand the instructions. Read all instructions carefully on screen before submitting any objection.

Step 2: Fill in the "Form to Raise Objection"

In the objection form, fill in the following required fields accurately:

  • Confirmation Number
  • Roll Number
  • Applicant Name
  • Subject Name
  • Test Date
  • Shift
  • Question ID (as mentioned in your Response Sheet)
  • Language in which the question was answered
  • Type of Objection
  • Remarks (optional but recommended)

Step 3: Handle Questions with Multiple Correct Answers

If a candidate believes that a question has more than one correct answer, they can select the option "Multiple Correct Answers" from the Type of Objection dropdown. Up to 4 option IDs can be entered, separated by commas.

Upload Supporting Documents and Submit

For each objection, candidates must upload valid supporting proof. Keep the following points in mind:

  • Mention the book name, page number, author name, publisher name/address, and year of publication as reference.
  • Upload the supporting document (clear and legible) in PDF, JPG, or JPEG format only.
  • Maximum file size: 400 KB per document.
  • Maximum 3 documents can be uploaded as supporting evidence per objection.
  • Objections submitted without valid explanation or reference will be discarded.
  • Once submitted, objections cannot be edited.

Important Rules for Raising Objections GSSSB CBRT 2026

Candidates must be aware of the official rules before submitting their objections to avoid rejection. The following rules apply to all three posts Staff Nurse (Ayurved), Junior Geologist, and Speech Therapist & Audiologist.

  • Only candidates who were physically present at the CBRT exam center on 25 June 2026 are eligible to raise objections.
  • Objections must be submitted online only. Objections through any other medium will not be accepted.
  • A candidate can raise objections for more than one question in a single session.
  • Objections must be submitted using the Question ID as mentioned in the Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet.
  • Objections can only be raised against questions and their corresponding answer options.
  • The Question ID, used for all references, is displayed to the right of the question in the response sheet.
  • Objections without valid proof and explanation will be considered invalid and discarded.
  • Supporting documents must be in PDF/JPG/JPEG format and must not exceed 400 KB in size.
  • Once an objection is submitted, it cannot be modified later.
  • Uploading a supporting document is mandatory before submission of each objection.

WBCS Prelims Answer Key 2026 - Direct Download Link

Candidates who appeared for the WBCS Preliminary Exam 2026 can download the answer key PDF directly from the official WBPSC website. The answer key contains the correct answers for all 200 questions asked in the exam, allowing candidates to cross-check their marked responses against the official key.

To access the answer key, candidates need to visit the official WBPSC portal and locate the relevant notice under the Examination/Answer Key section, since the file is hosted directly on the commission's website.

How to Download the WBCS Prelims Answer Key 2026?

This section explains the step-by-step process to download the official answer key PDF from the WBPSC website, in case candidates are unable to locate the direct download link.

  1. Visit the official website of the West Bengal Public Service Commission: www.wbpsc.gov.in.
  2. On the homepage, click on the "Examination" section, followed by the "Answer Key" tab.
  3. Look for the notice titled "Answer Keys to the MCQ Paper of W.B.C.S. (Exe.) etc. (Prelim) Examination 2023, Advt. No. 08/2024".
  4. Click on the "Click PDF to Download" link provided under that notice.
  5. The WBCS Prelims Answer Key 2026 PDF will open on the screen.
  6. Download and save the file, then match your marked answers with the official ones to calculate your tentative score.

WBCS Prelims 2026 Marking Scheme

Before calculating your expected score using the answer key, it's important to understand the official marking scheme followed by WBPSC for the Preliminary Examination. The exam follows a negative marking system, which directly affects the final tentative score.

Particulars Marks
Correct Answer +1 mark
Incorrect Answer -0.33 mark (negative marking)
Unattempted Question 0 mark

Using this scheme, candidates can calculate their probable score by multiplying the number of correct answers by 1, multiplying the number of incorrect answers by -0.33, and subtracting the second figure from the first.

How to Raise an Objection Against the WBCS Answer Key 2026?

If a candidate believes that any answer published in the official key is incorrect, WBPSC provides a formal window to challenge it. This section outlines the timeline and process for raising objections.

  • The objection window is open from 30th June 2026 to 6th July 2026.
  • Objections must be submitted in online mode only, through the official WBPSC website (wbpsc.gov.in).
  • Candidates are required to submit valid supporting documents (such as reference books or authoritative sources) to justify each objection raised.
  • Objections without proper justification or documentary proof may not be considered by the commission.
  • After reviewing all objections received, WBPSC will publish the final answer key, which forms the basis for preparing the Prelims result.

What Happens After the WBCS Answer Key 2026 Release?

Once the answer key is released and the objection process concludes, the recruitment process moves forward in the following stages:

  • Provisional Answer Key: Already released on 24 June 2026, allowing candidates to verify their responses.
  • Objection Window: Open from 30 June to 6 July 2026 for raising challenges to specific answers.
  • Final Answer Key: Published after WBPSC reviews and resolves all valid objections.
  • WBCS Prelims Result 2026: Expected to be released in July 2026, based on the final answer key.

WBCS Prelims Result 2026: What to Expect

Once the final answer key is locked in after the objection process, WBPSC will compile the results based on candidates' performance relative to the qualifying cut-off marks. Candidates who clear the Prelims stage will become eligible to appear for the WBCS Mains Examination, which is the next stage in the recruitment process for the West Bengal Civil Service (Executive) and allied posts.

How to Check Your JKSSB Answer Key 2026: Series A, B, C, D

The OMR exam was conducted using four question paper series A, B, C, and D meaning each candidate received one of these four versions of the question booklet. To check answers correctly:

JKSSB Answer Key Objection Process 2026

This section explains the step-by-step procedure, required documents, and fee for candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the provisional key.

JKSSB allows candidates to formally challenge any answer they believe is incorrect, provided the objection follows the prescribed format and is backed by supporting evidence. The objection window is short, so candidates should act promptly.

Key objection details:

Particular Details

Submission Mode Offline only

Documents Required Hard copies of documentary proof/evidence supporting the claim
Separate Forms Rule One form per question; if multiple questions are entered on one form, only the first will be considered

Steps to raise an objection:

  • Download Annexure "C" (objection proforma) from the official JKSSB notice
  • Fill in candidate details, application number, roll number, exam centre division, and the specific question number with series
  • State the objection clearly and attach hard-copy documentary proof supporting the claim
  • Prepare a demand draft of ₹200 per question in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
  • Submit the completed form, evidence, and demand draft in person at the Jammu or Srinagar JKSSB office within the 3-working-day window
  • Use a separate form for each question being objected to

JKSSB has clearly stated that objections will not be entertained after the stipulated period expires or if submitted through any mode other than offline in person.

What Happens After Objections Are Submitted?

This section explains the review process JKSSB follows once objections are received, and how it affects the final answer key.

Once the objection window closes, JKSSB reviews all submitted representations. If an objection is found correct, the answer key is revised accordingly for all candidates not just the one who raised it. However, JKSSB has clarified that no individual candidate will be notified about whether their specific objection was accepted or rejected. The final answer key, incorporating any approved corrections, is released subsequently and forms the basis for result preparation.

Cancelled Questions in MPSC LDCE Paper 1 and Paper 2 Final Answer Key 2026

Both the Paper 1 and Paper 2 final answer keys include a notice about cancelled questions. Understanding this cancellation policy is critical before calculating your score, as cancelled questions are excluded entirely from the evaluation process.

In both official PDFs, the following notice appears in Marathi: "# ने दर्शविलेले प्रश्न रद्द करण्यात आलेले आहेत", which translates to: "Questions indicated with the # symbol have been cancelled."

Key points about cancelled questions:

  • Any question preceded by the # symbol in the answer key is officially void for all candidates.
  • These questions are not evaluated and do not affect any candidate's score negatively.
  • As per standard MPSC practice, either marks for cancelled questions are granted to all candidates, or the total score is recalculated on a revised total excluding those questions.
  • This policy applies equally to both Paper 1 and Paper 2.
  • Candidates should download the official PDFs to identify the exact question numbers cancelled in each paper.

How to Download MPSC LDCE Paper 1 and Paper 2 Final Answer Key 2026

Accessing the official MPSC LDCE Final Answer Key PDFs for both papers is a straightforward process. Follow the steps below to download the correct answer key for your paper and begin verifying your responses.

  1. Visit the official MPSC website at mpsc.gov.in or use the direct PDF links provided above.
  2. Go to the Answer Key or Notifications section.
  3. Search for "LDCE Final Answer Key 2026" and select either Paper 1 or Paper 2 as applicable.
  4. Click on the respective PDF link to open or download the document.
  5. Confirm that your roll number appears within the listed range for that paper.
  6. Cross-check your answers question by question with the final answer key.
  7. Identify and skip all questions marked with # as they have been cancelled.
  8. Calculate your estimated score using the official MPSC LDCE marking scheme.

How to Calculate Your Expected Score

After downloading the final answer key for your paper, you can follow a systematic method to arrive at your estimated score. Here is a clear, step-by-step approach for both Paper 1 and Paper 2 candidates.

  • Step 1: Note down all the answers you marked during the examination.
  • Step 2: Identify questions marked with # in the answer key and exclude them entirely from your calculation.
  • Step 3: For all remaining questions, compare your response to the correct answer in the final key.
  • Step 4: Add the allotted marks for every correct response as per the MPSC LDCE marking scheme.
  • Step 5: If negative marking applies, deduct the specified marks for each incorrect answer.
  • Step 6: Total your marks to arrive at your estimated final score for the respective paper.

What Is the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Final Answer Key?

The Final Answer Key is the definitive, officially approved set of correct answers for the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director examination. It is published after the provisional answer key challenge window closes and all valid objections raised by candidates have been carefully reviewed by subject matter experts appointed by RPSC.

The final answer key carries absolute authority it is the version used to calculate the official marks of each candidate. Unlike the provisional answer key, no further objections can be raised against the final answer key. If any question was found to be incorrect, ambiguous, or contested through valid objections, RPSC may either revise the answer, award marks to all candidates who appeared for that question, or delete it entirely and all such changes will be reflected in the final answer key.

RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Exam Paper Structure

This section explains the two-paper pattern of the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director written examination to help candidates understand the scope of each answer key PDF.

The RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer examination consists of two papers, each carrying 100 marks and a duration of 2 hours. Together, both papers carry a combined total of 200 marks. Below is a summary of the subject coverage for each paper:

Paper Subject Areas Covered Total Marks Duration
Paper I Reasoning, Numerical Analysis, General Knowledge, Current Affairs 100 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II System Analysis & Design, Software Engineering, Software Project Management, Databases, Computer Networks 100 Marks 2 Hours

The minimum qualifying mark for the written examination is 40% in aggregate for General category candidates, and 36% for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. RPSC may additionally award up to 3 grace marks as per commission rules.

How to Download RPSC Final Answer Key 2026 for Analyst-cum-Programmer

Candidates can easily download both Paper I and Paper II final answer key PDFs from the RPSC official website by following the step-by-step process outlined below.

Step 1: Visit the official website of Rajasthan Public Service Commission at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, navigate to the "Answer Keys" section, which is available in the main menu or under the Quick Links area.

Step 3: On the Answer Keys page, look for the listing for "Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) - 2024."

Step 4: You will find separate download links for Paper I Answer Key and Paper II Answer Key.

Step 5: Click on the relevant link to open the answer key PDF in your browser.

Step 6: Download and save the PDF on your device.

Step 7: Cross-check your responses against the final answer key to estimate your marks in the examination.

Difference Between Provisional and Final Answer Key

Understanding the distinction between the provisional and final answer key helps candidates interpret the significance of this release.

RPSC follows a two-stage answer key process for all major examinations. First, a provisional answer key is published shortly after the examination, giving candidates an opportunity to raise objections against any answer they believe is incorrect by paying the prescribed objection fee. Once all objections are received and reviewed by an expert committee, RPSC publishes the final answer key. The final answer key incorporates all validated corrections, if any.

Stage Purpose Can Candidates Object?
Provisional Answer Key Initial set of answers for review Yes, within the objection window
Final Answer Key Verified correct answers for result computation No - final and binding

The score calculated using the final answer key will be the official score considered for merit list preparation.

What Happens After the RPSC Final Answer Key Is Released?

Once the final answer key for the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director exam is out, RPSC moves forward with the result and merit list preparation process. Candidates should be aware of the following next steps:

RPSC will evaluate all answer sheets using the final answer key. Based on this evaluation, the commission computes the marks scored by each candidate. A result preamble along with the cutoff marks for both the Main List and Reserve List will be published and notably, RPSC has already published the Result Preamble and Cutoff Marks (Main List) and (Reserve List) for the Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) 2024 examination on 22 June 2026 on the official website.

Candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for the next stages of selection, which typically include document verification and/or a personality test (interview), as per the selection process defined by RPSC for this post.

Keep checking rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in regularly for updates on the merit list, final result, and further recruitment notifications.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

Unattempted Questions 0 Marks

Candidates can use the formula below to estimate their total expected marks from Part B:

Expected Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

How to Raise an Objection Against the Provisional Answer Key

This section explains the step-by-step objection process, fee structure, and rules that GPSC has laid down for this answer key release.

GPSC has set up an Online Objection Submission System exclusively for this purpose. Here's how the process works:

  1. Objection window opens: 23 June 2026, 11:00 AM onwards

  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

Are you ready to join a team that thrives on excellence and embraces limitless potential? Fairmont Southampton, Bermudaâs largest resort, invites exceptional individuals to be part of our award-winning team and shape the future of hospitality.

Following a multi-million-dollar renovation, our 593-room resort is Bermuda's largest, featuring nine restaurants, a 30,000-square-foot spa, an 18-hole par three golf course and a captivating Beach Club. Opportunities for growth and success are boundless.

Our culture emphasizes respect, teamwork, and professionalism, supported by comprehensive benefits. Join our diverse and inclusive team, where your unique talents and perspectives are celebrated. Dare to go beyond the ordinary, unlock your potential and make a lasting impact at Fairmont Southampton. Together, let's create memories that exceed expectations. #BeLimitless

About The Application Process

At Fairmont, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

Job Description

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Fairmont Southampton as our new Staff Housing Coordinator. Reporting to the Director, Engineering & Facility Operations, the Staff Housing Caretaker is responsible for the overall maintenance, condition, and operational readiness of residential housing complexes, grounds, and associated facilities.

This role ensures that all properties are maintained to the highest standards of safety, functionality, and presentation. The Caretaker performs general maintenance and minor repairs while coordinating and overseeing specialized work (e.g., HVAC, electrical, plumbing) carried out by qualified contractors or certified technicians.

The position plays a key role in maintaining a safe, compliant, and high-quality living environment for residents by proactively managing maintenance programs, supporting capital projects, and ensuring efficient response to maintenance issues.

What You Will Be Doing

Maintenance & Repairs (Generalist/Multi-Skilled)

  • Perform general maintenance and minor repairs across housing units and common areas.
  • Carry out basic troubleshooting and non-specialized repairs related to:
    • Plumbing fixtures (e.g., leaks, blockages, fittings)
    • Electrical fixtures (e.g., light fittings, switches â non-complex work)
    • Air conditioning units (basic checks, cleaning, filter changes)
  • Complete carpentry, painting, masonry, and general upkeep tasks.
  • Repair and maintain door hardware, locks, and minor structural elements.
  • Escalate, coordinate, and oversee all major or certified work (HVAC, electrical, plumbing installations and complex repairs) to qualified vendors or licensed personnel.
  • Ensure all completed work meets required safety and quality standards.
Property & Grounds Upkeep

  • Conduct regular inspections of buildings, housing units, and outdoor areas.
  • Maintain cleanliness, safety, and visual appeal of properties and common spaces.
  • Support landscaping standards and general grounds maintenance.
  • Oversee pool maintenance through contractors or service providers, ensuring compliance with safety standards.
  • Identify and address potential maintenance risks proactively.

Preventative Maintenance & Asset Care

  • Implement and support preventative maintenance programs for housing facilities.
  • Schedule inspections and servicing of building systems through approved contractors.
  • Maintain detailed maintenance records and logs using the work order system (e.g., Transcendent).
  • Identify trends, risks, and potential failures and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure longevity and proper care of housing assets and equipment.

Contractor & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate and supervise external contractors and service providers.
  • Ensure all specialist work (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) is performed by licensed professionals.
  • Monitor contractor performance for safety, quality, timelines, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Support minor capital projects including planning, quotations, and execution.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety standards and company policies during project delivery.

Inventory, Materials & Planning

  • Maintain inventory of tools, supplies, and maintenance materials.
  • Plan and order materials proactively to support ongoing maintenance.
  • Ensure safe storage, handling, and use of tools and chemicals.
  • Track material usage and support cost control initiatives.

Tenant & Unit Readiness Support

  • Assist People & Culture team, to prepare units for new occupants.
  • Conduct pre- and post-occupancy inspections to ensure readiness and compliance along with People & Culture Team.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests and work orders.
  • Support a positive resident experience through timely and effective service delivery.

Work Order Management & Operational Support

  • Manage and complete work orders efficiently, prioritizing based on urgency.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all maintenance activities.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams regarding work status.
  • Respond to urgent or emergency situations as required.

Qualifications

What weâre looking for:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience

  • Proven experience in general maintenance, facilities, or caretaker roles.
  • Broad hands-on experience across maintenance disciplines (carpentry, minor plumbing, basic electrical, general repairs).
  • Experience coordinating contractors and overseeing maintenance work.
  • Hospitality or residential property experience preferred.

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Technical or vocational training in a trade is an asset.
  • Certifications in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or similar trades are not required but are a strong asset.
  • Valid driverâs license required.

Competencies, Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of general building maintenance and repair practices.
  • Understanding of when to escalate work to certified professionals.
  • Good knowledge of health and safety standards and compliance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage contractors and monitor work quality.
  • Proficiency in work order systems and maintenance tracking tools.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Embrace the Fairmont brand promise and luxury in your role and in all your interactions.
  • Foster an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and respected.

Personal Attributes

  • Reliable, responsible, and detail-oriented.
  • Practical, hands-on, and solutions-driven.
  • Proactive and able to anticipate maintenance needs.
  • Adaptable and responsive in a dynamic environment.
  • Professional and service-oriented when interacting with residents and teams.

Circumstances

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and on-call when required.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks (lifting, climbing, outdoor work).
  • Must be available for emergency response situations.

Additional Information

Employee Benefits

Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits. Add any other benefits relevant to your property.

Whatâs in it for you?

As part of Accor, a global hospitality leader with over 5,500 hotels worldwide, youâll enjoy:

  • Opportunities for growth and development, mentorship, and international mobility
  • Health insurance, retirement savings plans, and comprehensive wellness programs
  • Worldwide travel discounts and preferred rates across the Accor portfolio
  • A supportive, inclusive culture grounded in respect, teamwork, and professional development

Start your journey with us today and explore the possibilities! #BeLimitless

Our Values

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

Your Team And Working Environment

Fairmont Southampton is a premier luxury resort and regarded as a leader in the hospitality industry. Our mission is to turn moments into memories for our Guests. An exciting hospitality career awaits you if you are committed to providing our Guests with an authentically local experience through providing warm and engaging service.

Our Heartists work cohesively as part of the team in a demanding, multi-cultural diverse environment.

Our Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion

Fairmont is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Fantastic people are the key to our success. ButterflyMX is hiring a Principal PM who thinks at the intersection of funnels and customer experience. This role is about understanding how people move through a decision process, where they drop off, and what it takes to earn the next step. You'll own a product area that spans two connected user groups, one experiencing that journey firsthand, the other managing and optimizing it on the other side. We have an early roadmap to build from, but we need someone to pressure-test it, sharpen it, and own it. The right person for this role brings consumer product instincts, deep familiarity with AI-driven workflow automation, and a genuine obsession with conversion.

Role Snapshot
About Valiantys
Valiantys is a global professional services firm dedicated to helping engineering and service organizations transform how they work, using AI-enabled software delivery, modern ITSM, and platform engineering.

The opportunity
We're hiring a Chief of Staff to support the CEO. This role exists to increase the CEO's leverage, strengthen executive alignment, and improve the quality and pace of key decisions. It is not a substitute for operating leadership and does not own day-to-day company operations. Instead, the Chief of Staff acts as an extension of the CEO to drive clarity, follow-through, and executive coherence across the leadership team.

Location: This role can be located in the United States, (EST, New York City preferred). We offer flexible remote working policy.

What You'll Own
Operating cadence
Design and run the executive operating rhythm across a distributed leadership team. This includes C-suite meeting design, leadership team offsites, and the CEO's 1:1 cadence - ensuring each forum has a clear purpose, the right participants, the right pre-work, and concrete outputs.

Decision governance
Build and maintain the decision-making infrastructure for the exec team: RACI frameworks, decision logs, real-time commitment tracking. Make the implicit explicit. Document decisions as they're made, track what was decided, by whom, and what happens next.

Strategic progress tracking
Create the scorecards, dashboards, and executive reporting rhythms that give the CEO clear visibility into transformation priorities, business risks, and decisions requiring intervention. Partner closely with the COO and executive team to synthesize progress, surface slippage early, and sharpen the quality of discussion at the top. This role owns executive-level transparency and escalation.

Executive forum quality
Own the output quality of the company's most important executive forums. This means ensuring the right pre-reads exist, decisions are captured in real time, follow-through is tracked, and unresolved issues are escalated quickly. The standard is that every significant forum produces clarity, accountability, and momentum.

Executive communications
Craft the materials that shape the company's most important conversations: board updates, executive memos, decision briefs, CEO communications, investor-ready narratives, and sensitive internal messaging. Turn complex issues into crisp, well-structured communication tailored to senior audiences. Ensure the CEO enters key discussions with sharp materials, clear points of view, and decision-ready framing.

Thought partnership
Serve as a trusted sounding board to the CEO on strategic priorities, sensitive issues, and cross-functional tradeoffs. Translate complex discussions into structured options, clear decisions, and actionable next steps. Where appropriate, represent the CEO in selected forums with clearly defined delegated authority and return with sharp recommendations or follow-up actions.

How Youâll Drive Impact
The Chief of Staff focuses on sharpening priorities, improving executive decision-making, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and ensuring follow-through on the issues that matter most.

You will partner closely with the COO and leadership team to ensure the c-suite has clear visibility into execution, risks, dependencies, and decisions that require intervention.

You will operate across distributed, multi-regional leadership teams (US, Europe, APAC). You understand the asynchronous communication patterns, the coordination costs, and the discipline required to keep a globally distributed exec team aligned.

Success in the role comes from creating leverage, clarity, and momentum across the executive team.

What We're Looking For

  • A proven operator who has built executive operating rhythm in a 300 to 600 person professional services or B2B services business and knows what well-run looks like
  • Fluency in driving accountability through influence: building trust with senior leaders, holding peers accountable as a partner, and earning a mandate rather than asserting one
  • The ability to hold the full operating plan, see dependencies, and anticipate second-order effects before they surface as problems
  • Structured thinking that turns complexity and conflicting inputs into clear options and decisions
  • Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information and competing priorities, and a clear sense of when to push, escalate, or stay behind the scenes




Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of experience, including 2+ years in a Chief of Staff, Executive Strategy & Operations, GM, or equivalent operating role
  • MBA or equivalent; strategy consulting background a plus, not a requirement
  • A proven record of designing and building operating infrastructure for a distributed executive teams
  • Professional services, consulting, or B2B services background strongly preferred, , with a working understanding of the economics and the consultative model
  • Meaningful experience in transformation contexts: strategic pivot, M&A integration, or major operational change
  • PE-backed or high-growth experience, board exposure, and strong executive writing are each a plus




What Success Looks Like

  • The CEO is spending more time on the highest-value strategic priorities and less time on coordination overhead
  • The COO has more capacity to scale the business and lead day-to-day operations
  • Executive forums produce clearer decisions, better follow-through, and faster escalation of critical issues
  • Cross-functional priorities are visible, coordinated, and less dependent on the CEO personally chasing progress
  • Board and investor discussions are supported by more consistent, decision-ready materials and reporting




If this is you
This role suits an operator who builds the rhythm a leadership team runs on and leads through relationships rather than authority. You want to build something that matters, operate at pace inside a high-stakes transformation, and have a direct line to impact with visibility into the highest levels of decision-making.

Why you should apply ?
Our team members are our greatest asset and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.

Sense. We're committed to giving you the level of information you need to make sense of your assignments. You will witness the impact of your actions.

Training. We will provide you with the necessary time and budget to help you develop your skills and continue to build your career.

Flexibility. We understand that life is all about balance and we offer you the flexibility and support to help you maintain balance across the different pillars of your life.

What We Offer - Employee Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with an annual performance-based bonus
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance401(k) with Company Match
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) - 4 weeks per year, plus public holidays
  • A flexible remote work policy
  • A multicultural and international team environment




To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

As the Director of Sales Development, you'll set the targets, the operating model, and the standard for the entire XDR org, then build the leadership layer that runs it. The work isn't managing a room full of reps. It's building the people who build the pipeline: hiring, developing, and holding accountable the managers and team leads beneath you, so the function gets stronger whether or not you're in the room.

The stakes are straightforward. Leadership builds revenue plans on the number you deliver. That means owning capacity and ramp so pipeline scales in step with company goals, defending a forecast quarter after quarter with no asterisks, and getting Marketing, Sales, and RevOps aligned on what a qualified opportunity actually means. You own the stack and the spend too: pick the tooling and budget that make the team faster, and prove the return.

This is a seat for someone who wants to own outcomes, not activity reports. If you've built and scaled a sales development function before, know the difference between a team that's busy and one that's productive, and want your work to show up directly in how INNERGY plans its future, we should talk.d.

  • Plan the capacity. Own the headcount and ramp model so pipeline scales in step with company goals.
  • Defend the forecast. Deliver a pipeline number leadership can build revenue plans around, quarter after quarter.
  • Align the org. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps on segmentation, routing, and the definition of a qualified opportunity.
  • Own the stack and the spend. Choose the tooling and budget that make the team more efficient, and prove the return.

Role Snapshot

Virtual Assistant (Remote)

About the Company

ZEUS THERMAL, Inc. is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support daily business operations. This opportunity is ideal for a highly organized professional who enjoys administrative work, managing multiple tasks, and contributing to the efficiency of a growing organization while working remotely.

About the Role

As a Virtual Assistant, you will provide essential administrative support to help ensure smooth day-to-day operations. You will be responsible for managing communications, scheduling, data entry, file organization, and assisting with various business-related tasks. This role requires strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and the capability to work independently in a remote environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and organize email communications.
  • Schedule appointments, meetings, and calendar events.
  • Perform accurate data entry and maintain records.
  • Organize and manage digital files and documents.
  • Assist with daily administrative and operational tasks.
  • Coordinate information and communications between team members as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality of company information and records.
  • Support additional projects and business activities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in an administrative, virtual assistant, or support role preferred.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with computer applications and online collaboration tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Skills

  • Administrative support
  • Calendar management
  • Email management
  • Data entry
  • File and document organization
  • Time management
  • Communication skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Multitasking
  • Problem-solving
  • Microsoft Office and online productivity tools
  • Remote collaboration

Benefits

  • Fully remote work opportunity.
  • Flexible and independent work environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to a growing organization.
  • Professional development and skill-building opportunities.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

ZEUS THERMAL, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
